objective: Review two merge commits that bring release/0.3.1/integration (with the cloud start-branch fix and the Windows cleanup fix) into the capability and GPT-6 branches, and confirm each merged head builds to identical generated output and passes the gates.
scope: Worktrees: /home/user/holyagent-0.3.1-cap (HEAD edd4c34, merge into release/0.3.1/feat/capabilities) and /home/user/holyagent-0.3.1-gpt6 (HEAD 6628bc0, merge into release/0.3.1/feat/gpt-6-instructions). Both merged without conflicts.

For each: inspect git show --stat HEAD and git diff HEAD^1 HEAD; the generated bundles under packages/integrations/*/dist were merged textually, so run `bun install --frozen-lockfile`, `bunx --no-install mise run build` and confirm `git status --short` is empty afterwards (the merged bundle equals a fresh build), then `bunx --no-install mise run verify`. If the build changes files, report them; do not keep the changes (run git restore? no: make no git writes; just report).
constraints: Do not check out other commits in any checkout. Make no git writes and no source edits; the build may rewrite generated files, report any it changes.
Report in under 250 words; give command, exit code and test counts per worktree.

notes:
Both merges bring in the same 10 files from `release/0.3.1/integration`: `status.ts`, the Pi test-folder retry helper and tests, `cloud-checkout.test.ts`, and the two `dist` `holyagent.js` bundles. The `HEAD^1`-to-`HEAD` diffs differ only in blob hashes of the bundles, as expected for different bases.
I read the `status.ts` change (`startBranch` skips the clone's first move out of a detached HEAD at a full commit id). It has a vertical test, `takes the start branch from the platform's checkout after the clone`. `removeTemporary` has retry and give-up tests. I found no defects. Only the reflog and Windows behavior were read, not run on Windows.
The built-in `/code-review` ran from `/home/user/holyagent`, not from a worktree, so its `HEAD^1...HEAD` range was that checkout's own commit. Its findings (setup theme, `capabilities.ts`, `steps.ts`, `docs/usage.md`) are outside both merge diffs and I set them aside as unrelated to this review. They look like they concern the capability branch's own history, so the root may want a separate review there.
